title: Travel Processing Knowledge Review — Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement
display_label: Travel Processing Knowledge Review — Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement
content:
Travel Processing Knowledge Review

From the ORA eTraining module "Travel on Sponsored Projects: From Approval to Reimbursement" (lesson 7 of 8).
incorrect
Knowledge check: Which Banner pool level is used for grant-funded travel expenses?
  - 02  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - 04  [incorrect]
  - 09  [incorrect]
  - 15  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A Travel Authorization (TL) form is optional for booking flights on sponsored awards.
  - True  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - False  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A PI books a flight before submitting a TL form to secure a low flight cost. What is the concern?
  - No issue if funds are available  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Violation of required pre-approval process  [incorrect]
  - Allowable if under $500  [incorrect]
  - Only an issue for international travel  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Which of the following expenses is not allowed to be charged to a sponsored award?
  - Hotel taxes  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Ground transportation  [incorrect]
  - Room service  [incorrect]
  - Conference registration  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Airbnb lodging is allowable if it is cheaper that hotel alternatives.
  - True  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - False  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Remember that Airbnb is not an allowable vendor for travel lodging.
Knowledge check: A Principal Investigator plans to book a hotel 35 miles from campus for a 3-day conference where they will be presenting a paper generated from their sponsored project funding. Is lodging allowable?
  - Yes  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - No  [incorrect]
  - Yes, pending ORA approval  [incorrect]
  - Yes, pending sponsor approval  [incorrect]
  Note on "Yes": Remember the travel destination must be more than 40 miles from Morgan State University main campus to permit lodging expenses.
  Note on "No": Great job!
  Note on "Yes, pending ORA approval": Remember the travel destination must be more than 40 miles from Morgan State University main campus to permit lodging expenses.
  Note on "Yes, pending sponsor approval": This is tricky! Even with sponsor approval, Uniform Guidance stipulates we follow the strictest policy between sponsor, federal/state law, and University policy. Per University policy, this would be unallowable even with sponsor approval.
Knowledge check: Which of the following travel expenses can be charged to a University Purchasing Card?
  - Conference registration  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Flight costs  [incorrect]
  - Incidentals  [incorrect]
  - Networking dinners  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: What is true regarding student reimbursements on group travel requests?
  - Students can submit reimbursements individually  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Students cannot be reimbursed under group travel  [incorrect]
  - Reimbursement are optional at the PIs discretion  [incorrect]
  - Reimbursement requests are evenly split among travelers  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: Within how many days after returning from travel should a traveler submit a reimbursement request to the MSU Travel Office for processing?
  - 5 days  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - 30 days  [incorrect]
  - 60 days  [incorrect]
  - 7 days  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A traveler paid for the expenses below out of pocket on a recent trip to Denver for a conference: Taxi Fare: $50 Tip: $15 What amount is permitted for reimbursement?
  - $65  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - $60  [incorrect]
  - $50  [incorrect]
  - $55  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Remember that tip reimbursements are limited to 20% of the associated charge.
Knowledge check: Which of the following reduces the total reimbursement amount?
  - Meal per diem  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Travel advance  [incorrect]
  - Personal vehicle mileage  [incorrect]
  - Lodging costs  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: Try again.
Knowledge check: A PI wants to take a trip to Holland to give a presentation on their sponsored project research. The PI's Dean fully endorses the trip and is confident they can provide coverage for the PI's course load while on travel. What is the first question a research administrator should consider?
  - Does the Notice of Award allow international travel?  [CORRECT ANSWER]
  - Are there sufficient funds in the Banner travel pool?  [incorrect]
  - Has the PI selected an American airline?  [incorrect]
  - Does the conference focus relate to the project's scope?  [incorrect]
  If correct: Great job!
  If incorrect: While important to review, there may be a better "first" option.
